must_not_run_until: Root review approves this plan and commits an activated copy (activated true, activation.activated_at, activation.approved_by) before the first dispatch; the runner refuses anything else and every job requires that copy's SHA256 as a workflow input.
Discovery for a model runs, merges and its merged report is committed (path in stages.full.discovery_report) before that model's full stage is dispatched; full refuses otherwise.
scope: Additional named open-weight comparators on FGVC-Aircraft 2013b native VALIDATION only, on free GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runners (4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, CPU only). No TEST image is listed, downloaded, decoded or predicted: only IDs from the committed native-VAL manifest are ever fetched. No training, no hosted model APIs, no paid runners.
relation_to_other_plans: Separate from docs/aircraft-named-baseline-plan-v1.json (Qwen3.8-27B-8bit on the Mac GPU), which is unchanged. This plan reuses its inputs block, discovery sample and stage manifests verbatim and its stage_inputs function in code.

execution.image_seconds_note: Per-image hard deadline (the evaluator's _deadline guard). It is a wall guard only; it never changes decoding. 600 s replaces the evaluator's 120 s MPS value because CPU generation is slower (unmeasured until discovery).
execution.rule_new_image: A shard starts an image only if its elapsed seconds + image_seconds <= shard_wall_seconds; otherwise it stops partial and the merge refuses.
execution.dispatch_policy: Every dispatch of every (model, stage) is reported, with its run ID. All shard records merged together must share one run_id and one run_attempt, so re-running only failed shards is refused (no shard-level cherry-picking). At most two complete-stage dispatches per (model, stage); the first one whose merge succeeds is the result and later ones are not run. Decoding is greedy, so a re-dispatch cannot sample a more favourable answer.
execution.inputs_in_ci: docs/aircraft-ci-named-baseline-v1/inputs/fgvc-aircraft-2013b holds byte-identical committed copies of the three pinned inputs (SHA256 in inputs). The workflow copies them to data/fgvc-aircraft-2013b and downloads only the stage's native-VAL JPEGs from the pinned mirror, each checked against encoded_sha256 before use; stage_inputs then rehashes every pinned input and JPEG.

image_source.url_evidence: Same mirror and revision as data/fgvc-aircraft-2013b/candidates/fourshot-seed791/provenance.json. Spot check 2026-10-18: VAL 0034309 fetched by curl hashed (shasum -a 256) to its encoded_sha256 07a4a1be...
image_source.checked_against: val-images.json encoded_sha256 and encoded_bytes per image; the evaluator's author-byte clearance established that these bytes equal the author archive

qwen2-vl-2b-instruct.claim_label: Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct zero-shot (the untrained base of every controlled400 arm, no adapter), greedy
qwen2-vl-2b-instruct.why: Same base weights, dtype and profile as the eight evaluated endpoints with the LoRA removed: it isolates what the 400-image warm start and every later arm added over the pretrained instruct model.
qwen2-vl-2b-instruct.files_evidence: sha256: base.file_sha256 of reports/2026-10-17-controlled400-native-val/plan.json (the frozen evaluator plan); bytes: Hugging Face paths-info API at this revision, 2026-10-18 (total 4,429,621,382 equals base.total_bytes)

qwen2.5-vl-3b-instruct.license: Qwen Research License (non-commercial research use); LICENSE file pinned below
qwen2.5-vl-3b-instruct.dtype_note: The checkpoint's own torch_dtype. FP32 (about 15 GB of weights) does not fit a 16 GB runner, so this is a disclosed difference from the FP32 endpoints.
qwen2.5-vl-3b-instruct.claim_label: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct zero-shot, BF16 on CPU, greedy
qwen2.5-vl-3b-instruct.files_evidence: Large files: lfs.oid from the Hugging Face paths-info API at this revision, 2026-10-18 (not hashed locally; every CI download is hashed and refused on mismatch). Small files: downloaded by curl at this revision and hashed with Python hashlib on 2026-10-18.

runtime_source: runtime block of the frozen evaluator plan (reports/2026-10-17-controlled400-native-val/plan.json); installed exactly as the ci.yml local-vlm job does (uv sync --extra dev --locked, CPU torch 2.14.1/torchvision 0.29.1, requirements-vlm-local.lock) and checked by vlm_local_task_builder._check_runtime
profile_source: study.profile of docs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/activated-declaration.json (the evaluator's profile). lora_rank, num_generations and temperature are carried only so the shared Profile validates; no adapter is loaded and decoding is greedy.

generation.decoding: greedy: vlm_local_evaluation._generation_kwargs(profile) = max_new_tokens 256, do_sample False, use_cache True; the same as the eight endpoints
generation.prediction_code: vlm_local_evaluation.Backend.predict reused unchanged (native _inputs chat template, untruncated prompt cap, termination = last token in the EOS set)
generation.model_loading: AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained(local_files_only, trust_remote_code False, use_safetensors, sdpa), config.model_type must equal models.<key>.model_type; every snapshot file rehashed against models.<key>.files before load

prompt_and_parser.same_as: vision_rl.vlm_local_evaluation (eight-endpoint native-VAL evaluator): prompt_text(spec, "answer_only") over the complete 100-label vocabulary, parse_label(response, labels, allow_reasoning=True) only for a normally terminated generation
prompt_and_parser.prompt_sha256_evidence: Equal to prompt_sha256 in runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/bundle/plan.json and to runs/local-qwen8bit/aircraft-native-instruct-plan/prompt.txt (shasum -a 256, 2026-10-17); recomputed from data_spec by jq with the prompt_text formula.
prompt_and_parser.parser_source_sha256_evidence: sha256 of the parse_label source text in the evaluator frozen copy (runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/frozen/src) and on main c966df4 (identical), equal to parser_source_sha256 in the native-instruct probe plan.
prompt_and_parser.terminated_rule: finish_reason == "stop"; otherwise the answer is None (invalid, counted wrong)
prompt_and_parser.no_repair: Raw generated text is retained; no answer repair, fuzzy matching or retry.

inputs.image_preprocessing: fgvc-aircraft-rgb-remove-bottom20-v1 (shared aircraft_data transform; original JPEG, RGB, bottom 20 rows removed, no box crop, no external resize, no EXIF transposition); run_local rehashes model-visible pixels before each image

discovery.selection: Within each of the 100 classes, the native-VAL ID with the lowest SHA256 of compact JSON ["fgvc-aircraft-2013b","fgvc-aircraft-freshpool-screened-grpo-v1","baseline-discovery",791,label,id] (salt pinned by decision D13); evaluated in author order. Metadata only; no image or model output consulted.
discovery.role: Cost and validity diagnostic, never a benchmark score. It sizes the full stage.

gate.requires: the committed discovery report merged all 4 shards with zero refusals (merge_shard_records), which means 100 completed outcomes and no unknown or generation-error outcome
gate.overhead_seconds: max over discovery shards of (shard elapsed seconds - summed image latencies): download, hashing and model load
gate.shards_rule: ci_shards.full_shard_count(3333, mean_latency = discovery mean image latency, overhead, shard_wall_seconds 19800, image_seconds 600, safety_factor 1.5)
gate.max_latency_rule: stop if the largest discovery image latency exceeds image_seconds / 2 (300 s)
gate.on_stop: Report this model as incomplete. Profile, prompt, budget and sample stay fixed; any change is a new plan version.
gate.validity: Not gated: invalid answers are part of the zero-shot baseline and count as wrong. This deviates from the 27B plan's 0.9 floor, which existed to protect GPU time; CI time costs nothing here.

full.shards: derived by the gate; the full workflow input must equal it, and run-shard and merge both recompute it from the committed discovery report

analysis.metric: mean(diag(row_normalized_confusion)) via vision_rl.classification_comparison (_inputs/_score), micro accuracy supplemental; invalid, unterminated and missing answers stay in their class denominators
analysis.canonical_rule: canonical_label = parse_label(response, labels, allow_reasoning=True) if status completed and terminated else None; the merge re-parses every response and refuses any stored label that differs
analysis.comparisons: compare_classification(gold, endpoint, baseline, labels, resamples 20000, seed 2718) for each endpoint, so delta = endpoint minus named baseline; stratified-image and class-cluster bootstrap as implemented there

endpoint_predictions.evidence: Extracted 2026-10-18 by plain Python (no vision_rl import) from runs/aircraft-native-val-activation-v1/bundle/arms/<arm>/predictions.jsonl outcome events (result.canonical_label). Each journal's SHA256 equals prediction_journal_sha256 in reports/2026-10-17-controlled400-native-val/comparison.json, and the recomputed macro accuracy equals that file's value for all three arms (difference < 1e-12).

analysis.claim_limits: Development (VAL) comparison only. VAL is the selection set for the strongest-SFT choice. A named baseline claim requires all 3,333 predictions merged with zero refusals. Pretraining contamination of public FGVC images is not excluded. TEST stays sealed.

deviations: CPU instead of MPS, 4 torch threads instead of 2: numerics can differ from the endpoints' MPS runs at the last bit; disclosed, not equalised.
Qwen2.5-VL-3B runs in BF16 (its checkpoint dtype) because FP32 does not fit a 16 GB runner.
Per-image deadline 600 s instead of 120 s (CPU speed); it is a guard, not a decoding change.
No validity floor in the discovery gate (see stages.full.gate.validity).
